batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan of the JU D Unit 2010-2011 paper in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2010-2011-set1.pdf (7 pp.). The printed header (p.1) reads: প্রথমবর্ষ স্নাতক সম্মান ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১০-২০১১, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, ঘ ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, সময়- ১ ঘণ্টা, পূর্ণমান- ১০০, 'সেট কোড: ১' — the Drive listing label 'Set-1' AGREES with the printed set code, so there is no listing-vs-printed discrepancy. 100 questions: Biology 50 (Botany Q1-25, Zoology Q26-50 — per the project JU D convention, subject 'Biology' with the split carried in topic), Chemistry 40 (Q51-90), General Knowledge 2 (Q91-92), Bangla 4 (Q93-96), English 4 (Q97-100). No subject headings are printed anywhere in the compilation; subjects and the Botany/Zoology split are assigned per question by content. Key form: the compilation prints a ব্যাখ্যা after each question and a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key (Bangla letters ক-ঘ, mapped positionally to a-d); the English block (Q97-100) prints Latin option labels (a)-(d) and Latin-letter key boxes. All 100 questions keyed; 0 dual; 0 keyless; 0 printed no-correct-option dispositions. One box-vs-ব্যাখ্যা conflict (Q46): the printed box key is recorded and the conflict documented in the question note (the batch convention for these solved-paper scans). This paper is the same question pool as Set-2 (ju-d-2010-2011-set2) in a different printed order, transcribed independently from its own scan. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification. sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit Admission Test 2010-2011 — printed SET CODE: 1 (AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan; Drive listing 'Set-1')
sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint (boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' keys in Bangla letters ক-ঘ; ব্যাখ্যা lines printed for most questions in Set-1 and for some questions in Set-2). Red aggregator banners 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com' / 'Get All University Admission Update...' and a diagonal 'ADMISSION WAR' watermark are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper; the watermark covers several key boxes, which were read from quadrant crops and, where needed, minimum-channel enlargements that suppress the coloured watermark. Two-column layout. Downstream cross-check partner (not used here): Satt Academy's JU D 2010-11 year-bank aggregates.
